work_title: Fix missing tokens, box #0 UTXOs, segment binary search, and rollback in ExtraIndexer (#2210)
description: Fixed missing tokens and token UTXOs in ExtraIndexer/IndexedToken/Segment: included globalBoxIndex == 0L in retrieveUtxos, made Segment.modBox directional/idempotent without mutating unmatched binary-search probe segments, preserved segment counts in IndexedToken.addEmissionAmount, guarded unvalidated re-mints and duplicate intra-tx inputs, and properly rolled back tokens and their child box segments in ExtraIndexer.removeAfter, with regression tests in SegmentSpec, ExtraIndexerSpecification, and ExtraIndexerReorgTokensSpec (ergoplatform/ergo#2210). Upstream PR: https://github.com/ergoplatform/ergo/pull/2875.
